The '''Zarracina sector''' was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Ashash system/Legends|Ashash]], [[Selsor system/Legends|Selsor]], and [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina systems]]. The Ashash [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Ashash]], and the Selsor system included an astronomical object of the [[Selsor|same name]], on which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] once carried out a successful [[Winter/Legends|winter]] campaign. When a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point was discovered in the Zarracina system in [[11,660 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was set on acquiring the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]], but resistance by the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Zarracine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] led to a Republic [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|orbital bombardment]] of the planet, which sent it into a state of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] winter.

==Description==
The Zarracina [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Trailing" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Baroli sector/Legends|Baroli]] and [[Tacuni sector/Legends|Tacuni sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction. It also formed a four-way border with the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak]], [[Brevost sector/Legends|Brevost]], and [[Citlik sector/Legends|Citlik sectors]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] and another four-way border with the [[Chaykin sector/Legends|Chaykin]], [[Immeria sector/Legends|Immeria]], and [[Immerian Outback/Legends|Immerian Outback]] sectors [[spinward]].<ref name="Expansion" />

The westernmost section of the Zarracina sector contained the [[Ashash system/Legends|Ashash system]], while the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]] lay in the more eastward portion of the sector.<ref name="Directions">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Zarracina [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of [[Ashash system/Legends|Ashash]] in grid square N-14 and [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina]] in squares O-14, which corresponds to the westernmost and more eastward sections of the sector, respectively, per {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}.</ref> The [[Selsor system/Legends|Selsor system]] lay close to the sector's southeastern border.<ref name="Expansion" />

==Locations==
[[File:Selsor-TEA.png|thumb|left|300px|The Selsor system was a part of the Zarracina sector.]]
The Ashash [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] of the [[Ashash|same name]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Gas-emitting creature|creature]] that could emit a harmful [[Gas/Legends|gas]] from its body.<ref name="Battle">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> The terrestrial celestial body [[Selsor]],<ref name="Rules">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> located in the Selsor system,<ref name="EAOC" /> was the site of a successful [[Winter/Legends|winter]] campaign carried out by the [[Snow Hawks]] [[cold assault stormtrooper]] unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rules" />

The Zarracina system included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]], the homeworld of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Zarracine]] species. In [[11,660 BBY]], a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point was discovered in the Zarracina system. Due to the discovery's strategic nature, acquiring Zarracina III became a priority for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was under the control of the [[Speciesism|speciesist]] [[Pius Dea]] cult at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. The subsequent attempts by the Republic at both [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] and [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade|conquest]] of the planet were unsuccessful. In response, the Republic carried out an [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|orbital bombardment]] of Zarracina III, sending it into a state of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] winter and causing the [[Speciecide|near-extinction]] of the Zarracines. The remaining natives of the planet adopted a nomadic existence, and the Republic subsequently annexed the Zarracina system.<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zarracina sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was illustrated on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares N-14, O-14, and O-15.<ref name="Expansion" />
